title: LookNight
description: How the game shows the compute night (B7, B2579/B2580, D637 R12-R14): the picture darkens into the dream scene when the night begins and the morning fades in once the AI service is done. Presentation only; all values are placeholders until Marcel's word.

fade_out_s.description: Real seconds the picture takes to darken into the dream scene.

fade_in_s.description: Real seconds the morning takes to fade in.

min_scene_s.description: The dream scene stays at least this long (real seconds), also when the service has nothing to do - short, but without a jolt.

darkness.description: How dark the dream scene is at most (0 = the world as it is, 1 = black). Below 1 the sleeping world stays faintly visible.

poll_s.description: Real seconds between two questions to the service how far the night is (GET /phase).
